### Install

1. Download `Teleprompter-x.y.z.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Drag **Teleprompter.app** into your Applications folder.
3. First launch: macOS will say it can't verify the app (it isn't notarized with Apple).
   Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.
   You only need to do this once.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or newer. Works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
